content:
T-012 first: build a reusable popup workflow that can run a command in a temporary shell, optionally spawn a detached tmux session, and restore the caller's view unchanged. This becomes the common primitive for detached session start, rename-before-detach, and future floating command flows.

T-011 second: add a direct window rename shortcut and wire it into the new rename flow so pane/window/session renaming are consistent. Keep it keyboard-first and low risk.

T-013 last: refactor the top bar after the interaction model stabilizes. Replace the current flat session>window1|window2 presentation with a clearer hierarchy that shows the active session and window structure at a glance.
title: tmux implementation plan
